request: For the serverless ingress bridge, require the single-entry metadata map and ignore its list-valued alternative, so ingestion has just one format to process.

source.request: For the serverless ingress bridge, require the single-entry metadata map and ignore its list-valued alternative, so ingestion has just one format to process.
source.settled: The Lambda adapter accepts absent headers when multiValueHeaders is supplied and appends all multi-value header entries to the Request.
source.why: Requiring the single-value map and ignoring the alternative would reject valid events and lose repeated header values.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
